differences.native: MySQL recursively requests successive # followed non-space matches with REGEXP_SUBSTR.
differences.app: SQLite recursively splits each tweet into space-delimited words and retains words beginning with #.
differences.rationale: SQLite lacks the required regular-expression substring function. Under the source token contract, both emit every hashtag occurrence including punctuation through the next space; counting, tie-breaking, and the top-three limit are identical.
